title.narrative: Making every woman and girl count
Ogni donna deve contare – Making every woman and girl count

description.narrative: L’iniziativa, della durata di tre anni, si inserisce nel più ampio programma globale Women Count – Fase II realizzato da UN Women e mira, con un approccio trasformativo, a rafforzare gli istituti e i sistemi statistici dei paesi target nel campo della produzione e diffusione delle statistiche di genere, e in particolare la produzione e l’utilizzo di dati sull’empowerment economico delle donne e della violenza contro le donne, introducendo elementi di modernizzazione e innovazione nei processi statistici e aumentando l’accessibilità e l’utilizzo delle statistiche di genere nelle politiche pubbliche.

The initiative is part of the broader global Women Count proiect, implemented by UN Women, and aims, with a transformative approach to strengthen the statistical institutes and systems of the target countries in the field of production and dissemination of gender statistics, and, in particular, the production and use of data on the economic empowerment of women and violence agains women, introducing elements of modernization and innovation in statistical processes and increasing the accessibility and use of gender data and statistics in public policies.

sector.narrative: Ending violence against women and girls
Women's rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls

By 2020, enhance capacity-building support to developing countries, including for least developed countries and small island developing States, to increase significantly the availability of high-quality, timely and reliable data disaggregated by income, gender, age, race, ethnicity, migratory status, disability, geographic location and other characteristics relevant in national contexts

By 2030, build on existing initiatives to develop measurements of progress on sustainable development that complement gross domestic product, and support statistical capacity-building in developing countries
Eliminate all forms of violence against all women and girls in the public and private spheres, including trafficking and sexual and other types of exploitation
End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere

Recognize and value unpaid care and domestic work through the provision of public services, infrastructure and social protection policies and the promotion of shared responsibility within the household and the family as nationally appropriate
Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development
